description: Live Testnet deployment, redeployed and verified end-to-end on 2026-09-13. Every id above was read back from the live network after deployment. Verified live on this contract: initialized with the configured admin, config_version 1, the policy gate pointing at the safeguard-policy contract id above, sac_passthrough false, and the sandbox token bound; the admin lifecycle was then exercised for real -- freeze and unfreeze on the bound token both succeeded against the ledger. Earlier verification, 2026-09-08: DEFINE (safeguard-policy) + ENFORCE (compliance-hooks) wired together. Verified live: compliant operations allowed through the real policy contract; frozen parties revert Error(Contract, #4); a policy-denied party (suspended identity record) reverts #3; unbound tokens revert #2; the real getEvents stream parses cleanly through safeguard-audit's verified wire model. Redeployed 2026-09-08 with the gas-optimized wasm (release profile: opt-z, LTO, codegen-units 1, panic=abort; docs/performance.md): enforcement gates cost ~10-12% less per operation. The admin secret key lives in the SAFEGUARD_ADMIN_SK env var only — never in this file. Confidential Tokens on Stellar are a developer preview; treat this deployment as rehearsal, not production.
